conventions: independence stated in the first screen
one primary action ('Discuss a Project') always in the header
research items carry a type label and a date
sources and method under every figure

directions.name: The Journal
directions.thesis: Present the firm as its publication: the current study is the first screen, on paper, in a serif.

theme.note: paper ground, one accent, a single dark figure panel; in Kakde's cream, navy and emerald

typography.note: serif for thought, tracked small caps for wayfinding; set in Source Serif 4 and JetBrains Mono

hero.note: work-as-hero card: the flagship study left, its chart right

navigation.note: one row of small-caps links under the wordmark; hides on scroll down, returns on scroll up

footer.note: large wordmark beside a ruled index of sections

layout.note: dated, typed research row directly under the hero

hover.note: underline draws via background-size over 0.3s ease

responsive.note: 4 to 2 to 1 column, headline steps down

components.note: a current chart with its source beside the lead item

buttons.note: the current solid block button and arrow text link

reveals.note: 0.8s staggered rise, lines drawn on load

directions.bestFor: readers who judge a research firm by its research
risks: needs a steady flow of new work to keep the first screen fresh

directions.name: The Instrument
directions.thesis: The firm as a measuring device: a position in two lines over a field of real data, inside a ruled frame.
directions.coherenceNote: theme and typography both come from the anchor

theme.note: deep ground with the accent reserved for the action; in Kakde's navy and emerald rather than their navy and red

typography.note: one light sans at 64px / 1.2 / -0.011em; set in Inter 300

hero.note: two-line statement, short paragraph, two buttons, a bar field rising from the fold; bars are the firm's own value-creation data

details.note: pill labels introduce each section; 1px frame rails

layout.note: dark hero then a light evidence band

navigation.note: filled CTA fixed in the header's right corner

scroll.note: stepped list that fills in as it is scrolled

directions.bestFor: allocators and quants; the natural home for the globe hero
risks: closest to a direct competitor's structure: palette, type and data are Kakde's so it is not mistakable for them
light weights need care at small sizes

directions.name: The Ledger
directions.thesis: Be the one a visitor remembers: tall capitals, ruled drawings, solid colour, a question to answer.

theme.note: stone ground with ink and one green as solid fields

typography.note: tracked capitals at 0.06em for display, serif italic for the line beneath; Inter 600 stretched, since the brand has no condensed face

buttons.note: full-width bordered bar with tracked caps

hero.note: one statement fills the first screen beside a plate

components.note: 'What are you deciding?' circular chooser routing four kinds of question

layout.note: evidence as a grid of cards, a chart among them

media.note: one treatment for every image; here a ruled line-drawing system, which needs commissioning

reveals.note: 1s opacity only; the type does the work

footer.note: wordmark in display capitals over lowercase columns

directions.bestFor: standing out in a field of navy-and-white sites
risks: needs commissioned illustration to be finished
uppercase display is harder to read at length
